scope: Bounded one-kernel Gaussian genomic ML/REML and reusable cross-kinship BLUP; partial genomic mixed-model support,not GWAS.

common_contract.input: Finite nonempty rectangular inputs,abs<=1e150,<=1Mcells; ntraining4..128,pfixed0..16,n>p+2. Exact row order retained for K and queries. No observation weights/missing response. Intercept automatic.
common_contract.kernel: Supplied exactly symmetric PSD K; diagonal mean positive and representable; any unequal mirrored entries reject (including roundoff asymmetry), so callers must explicitly symmetrize before fitting. max(|Kij|)/maxdiag<=1e4; eigenvalues below -1e-12*max(1,maxeigen) reject. Roundoff-small negative eigenvalues are clipped to zero; likelihood and training BLUP use that effective PSD kernel, saved normalized weights are restricted to its strictly positive eigenspace. Symmetric original training cross-rows reuse the same fitted BLUP to eigensolver rounding. K normalized by original mean diagonal for scale-invariant h.
common_contract.likelihood: V=sigma_g^2 K+sigma_e^2 I;normalized R(h)=(1-h)I+hK/mean(diagK),sigma_g^2=profile_scale*h/meanDiagK,sigma_e^2=profile_scale*(1-h). ML denominatorn,REMLdenominatorn-p-1. REML includes logdet of original-design X^TR^-1X; response and fixed-feature unit changes carry required likelihood constants.
common_contract.optimizer: Evaluate uniform h grid including0/upper,refine all resolved interior and endpoint-neighbor minima with golden sections,retain exact boundaries. <=30000profileevaluations. No global optimum theorem; grid can miss unresolved narrow interior extrema. Flat observed profile relative1e-9 returns components_identified=false/converged=false. Active upper bound returns converged=false; lower zero-genetic boundary can converge. Conditional fixed effects and BLUP use fitted covariance.
common_contract.numerics: Response/features use origin-relative dimensionless differences; eigenspace weighting and Cholesky of standardized whitened normal Gram with relative diagonal-pivot1e-12. Numerically perfectly explained response relative residual norm<=1e-12 rejects; no positive-scale Gaussian MLE claimed. Component variance products use logarithms. Portable prediction expands each physical term including y_scale into binary mantissa/exponent products and ratios and uses compensated floating expansions before conversion to binary64; finite zero/nonzero effects survive intermediate overflow, underflow, and large cancellation, including subnormal kernel/feature units. Finite precision and eigensolver tolerance still apply. Positive fitted variance underflowing physical binary64 rejects with rescaling guidance.
common_contract.saved_model: [version1,n,p,y_origin,y_offset_scaled,y_scale,standardized_intercept,kernel_mean_diagonal,feature_origins(p),feature_mean_offsets_scaled(p),feature_difference_scales(p),standardized_slopes(p),positive_support_normalized_kernel_weights(n)]. Length8+4p+n. Algebraic prediction=y_origin+y_scale*(y_offset+fixed_normalized+(crossK/kernel_mean_diagonal)dotweights), evaluated in physical term scales. CrossK rows must share the training kernel units/order. With clipped near-PSD training K, weights remove clipped/null training directions; query crossK is interpreted against that retained support. No query/query covariance or full joint-PSD check is performed.
common_contract.uncertainty: No variance-component inference or fixed-effect SE. Normalized h is not a general biological heritability estimate unless the caller kernel normalization/model assumptions justify it. No installed-JMP head-to-head comparison.

operations.description: Gaussian y=Xbeta+g+e with supplied PSD kinship K; rows[y,fixed covariates...,K row]; [p,method0ML/1REML=1,h_upper=.99999999,grid=128,tol=1e-10]. Bounded nonnegative variance components; profile likelihood and BLUP.
operations.data: n training rows[y,fixed numeric covariates(p),K_i0...K_i(n-1)]. n4..128,n>p+2,p0..16,one phenotype and one supplied kinship.
unsupported: GWAS tests and marker-specific variance refits
Asymmetric kernels, including unequal mirrored entries within former roundoff tolerance; explicitly symmetrize before fitting

operations.description: Saved Gaussian genomic model scoring: rows[fixed covariates(p),cross-kinship to n training individuals]; unchanged kinship_model.predict_parameters. Reuses fixed effects and training kernel weights.
operations.data: Query rows[p original fixed covariates,n cross-kinship values in exact training-row order]. No query outcomes or variance fitting.
unsupported: Refitting new genetic effects from observed query phenotypes
Checking the full joint query/training PSD kernel without query/query covariance
Inferring a corrected joint query/training PSD kernel from query cross-covariances alone
